_comment: Manually updated list: per platform, from which CS2 game version (stored in the demo,
e.g. 14201) the server MAY announce all-talk in the chat. Each entry applies from
alltalk_notices true : look for on_text / off_text in the server chat; those times are
all-talk (both teams mixed). No notice found = no all-talk.
alltalk_notices false: never all-talk during the match.
In doubt (unknown platform/version): false. Never mix both teams without proof.
If FACEIT stops announcing it or changes the text in a new game version, add an entry
